videos.title: How to build an agent that builds the culture — Zach Bruggeman, Ramp
videos.summary: At fintech giant Ramp, an astonishing 75% of all production code is now written and shipped by their collaborative AI agent, Inspect—achieved without a single top-down mandate. This talk dismantles the prevailing hype around isolated 'lone wolf' developers, revealing the battle-tested playbook for embedding multiplayer AI directly into team workflows to eliminate information silos and build institutional trust. If you want a concrete, behind-the-scenes look at how engineering organizations will actually build and ship software in the agentic era, this masterclass is an indispensable watch.

videos.title: Engineer Your Coding Agents Like Any Other System — Zach Lloyd, Warp

If you want to future-proof your engineering career and discover how modern software will actually be built at scale, this talk is an essential blueprint.
